-- Get the latest measurement per session (one record per session, most recent)
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    CASE WHEN notes = '' THEN NULL ELSE notes END as notes
FROM measurements
JOIN (
    SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as max_date
    FROM measurements
    GROUP BY session_id
) latest ON measurements.recorded_at = latest.max_date
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC;

args.query:
-- Create a view with deduplicated latest measurements
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS latest_measurement_per_session;
CREATE VIEW latest_measurement_per_session AS
SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    m.recorded_at,
    m.status,
    CASE WHEN m.notes = '' THEN NULL ELSE m.notes END as notes
FROM measurements m
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as max_date
    FROM measurements
    GROUP BY session_id
) latest ON m.recorded_at = (
    SELECT MAX(m2.recorded_at) FROM measurements m2 WHERE m2.session_id = m.session_id
)
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, m.session_id;
